notes.title: Omni Link Release Date - September 4th
notes.notes:
When I played through the entire story the other day and the credits rolled. I was really moved with emotions. The ending is truly epic to the tale I've been building the last two years and I can't wait tell you all experience it. The last chapter is truly the best of them all.

[b]I'm happy to announce that Omni Link is complete and will be released September 4th.[/b] They often call a game when finished "Gold". My game at the moment is "Gold plated". I only need till Sep. 4th to iron out the last few things.

I've always wanted Omni Link is be a story you experience more than you read. I can safely say, that it's become like that for me.

Thankyou Steam Community for "Early Access" which made this possible!

notes.title: Progress update - July 23 - Walls are closing in!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26346321/0b7244b8c503402db411cba1c101efd72263f121.png[/img]

The game is almost finished! I'm waiting for game release to update the build. Here is a list of recent fixes and additions focusing on major changes only:

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Changed & added backgrounds in key areas.
    [*]New dialogue bar and mission graphics
    [*]Enhancements to choices:
- Wording popup now appears showing you if the character liked your choice.
- Reputations with characters branch dialogue and gameplay in key scenes.
    [*]Bounty system fully implemented:
    [*]New HUD icon underneath money/credits icon
- Characters talk about your bounty and it will affect gameplay elements
- Currently only relationship with Zoas and attacking neutral ships affects bounty.
    [*]Manga panels added to Prologue
    [*]Manga panels added to Dawn fight
    [*]Main menu finished
    [*]Ending Credits added
    [*]Added two new songs and swapped one
    [*]Suzumi's brother now has a face
    [*]Added “Graphic Buttons” when making unique choices or interacting with objects
    [*]Alias and other names picked at different times (other than at game start)
    [*]Added more “one-chance-to-get-it-right” choices
    [*]Two new character outfits added for Dawn & Arcadia
    [*]Various lines of voice acting added to important scene
    [*]Universe littered with more things to do and explore
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Darkstar now flees when you allow escape, not stopping game progress
    [*]Can now access pirate base if allied with Celine
    [*]Scene transitions, balancing, character positions
    [*]*Other things mentioned by you in forum “bugs” topic
    [*]*spoiler fix
[/list]
[b]Still left to do:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Bigger exploration maps for Suzumi missions
    [*]“Relationship not high enough” events
    [*]Mission tracker & information for new quests
    [*]Two new gameplay puzzles
    [*]Achievement and trading card art
    [*]Testing activation of achievements > Deciding which ones I want!
    [*]Adding ship ideas 
    [*]Editing (on-going)
[/list]
Most of these changes are off the top of my head. I don't usually keep track of fixes as I work. I'm really liking the quality-of-life improvements made in the last weeks.

notes.title: Summer Update and Release Date Closing in!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26346321/7e4f2f3613f9ee75163e3525e08d5d276232c975.png[/img]

It's summer time!

In a previous progress update, I mentioned the release date is getting close when I start to implement your ideas for ship designs. https://steamcommunity.com/app/529100/discussions/0/224446614459439411/

I'm doing that now! So post your ideas if you want a chance of getting in. [u][b]You will be in the credits of my game if I pick your ship idea.[/b][/u]

I also want to share that the game is playable from beginning to end in my internal build. The stage I am at is play testing, polishing, side missions, and editing. The wait is almost over.

[b]Release Date:[/b]

I originally wanted to release my game this month, but Steam likes to have sales in the summer. Instead, I decided that it would be best to release my game and launch discount 30 days after the next Steam sale which is usually mandatory for spacing out sales on Steam. Because you've been so patient waiting for release, the next Steam sale is going to have a better discount than the traditional game launch discount and a little higher than I would normally put.

[i][b]EDIT: I want to release the game next month if possible[/b][/i]

The extra time will also be used to finish the things I haven't been thinking of. [u][b]Game Achievements & Steam Trading Cards[/b][/u] so it works out better this way.

[b]An Epic Adventure that You are Apart of:[/b]

I think you will be very pleased with how the story plays out. It's completely epic, and very unexpected. You will notice most of the Fantastic Artwork was saved for near the end. 

I tried to make each character enduring so choices will be hard... including that of romance. I originally wanted only one save file so choices would be permanent. These choices make it so you can really feel like you are the protagonist of the story.

I also tried to make [b]rewarding choices[/b]. The gameplay may be simple, but it allows for me to easily convey your choices in a way that other Visual Novels can't. But Omni Link is a visual novel first and a shooter game second. There is a ton of dialogue near the end. 

On easy difficulty, you may skip gameplay elements quickly with brute strength just to enjoy the story.  The hardest difficulty is meant to be unforgiving, just like the Virus is in the story. When you lose a ship, it is gone forever. You may reach the end of the game with no ships and little chance of winning. As it should be.

I can't wait to see you next month!

notes.title: Free Manga & Game Update Announcment
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26346321/3b8435010247c1b917001b1a0b4196b66f9cbb5d.png[/img]

[h1] Omni Link Manga released:[/h1]

My first words are a shout out to my friends and family that have made the story of Omni Link possible. They not only helped with funding, but emotional cheers of support as well. It is your support on Steam and other places that has made these projects possible.

[url=https://medibang.com/book/4f1801050906064650003767461] Omni Link Manga[/url]

[i]*read and share the link with all your friends. For those that play the game, you'll notice the story's beginning is similar, yet unique in it's own way. Some events are entirely new. Issue #1 ends with Dawn's first test of strength on Remnos station. I'm sure many of you wanted to see that scene play out, and now you can :)[/i]

[h1] Video Game release date:[/h1]

WIth the first comic/manga release out of the way, I can focus my attention 100% on the game. I don't yet know when I can release the game. That's not to say I don't know when I can finish the core game. There are reasons I can't be be more specific. You will know the time is close for release when...(read below). Sorry, I'm so vague.

[h1] Want to get more involved:[/h1]

1) Before the games release I plan to introduce your ship ideas and side-quest ideas into the game. I think it would be fun for you to have a chance to be a part of the game in that way. [i]*I'm hoping at least one of you will be able to design a character for the game too.[/i]

I will include these new pieces of content (your ships & side-quests) into the game, after the game is completely finished. So when I start asking for this information, you know the time is close for release.

2) If you want to support the game the most, get it during early access. All early access purchases increase the production value of the game including: new art, characters, music, and a manga for you to enjoy.

3) Share the manga with eveyone. [url=https://medibang.com/book/4f1801050906064650003767461] Omni Link Manga[/url]

4) For exclusive info, art, and story, be a part of my Patreon:

[url=https://www.patreon.com/roencia] Patreon Updates[/url]

Thankyou!

notes.title: Omni Link Update 0.7 - Out of Darkness
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26346321/ebe659d34f1a0491f68a38eaa1602a18848fbabc.gif[/img]

[h1]Latest Patch Notes:[/h1]

A new update released and now is a great time to join in the experience. It occurred to me as I'm working on the game... this is early access! Let's give them what I've got so far.

Take in mind that this is a stepping stone and still early access. I'm still missing assets and other things I want to add. Post any bugs in the forum (or improvement suggestions) so I can fix them. Post your ship ideas in the forum sticky so that I can add them to the game. This is the long list of changes:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26346321/7404c7fb14adbbbc4c4a5cdece009a7c97d1932e.gif[/img]

[h1]Content Updates:[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]New Save System[/b] – Save into 9 slots that take screenshots of your progression.
[*][b]7 New avatars[/b] making 17 in total.
[*][b]6 new hand drawn scenes[/b] making 11 in total.
[*][b]12 new backdrops[/b] making 17 in total.
[*][b]4 new ships[/b] making 15 ships in total. - I have more ships, but I'm focusing on main story first. Then I will flush out ships, balancing and side quests.
[*][b]1 Huge chapter 3 path choice[/b] – Consequences to your major choices in chapters 1 and 2 begin in chapter 4. The major one being, what did you do to the pirates?
[*][b]Brand new prologue[/b] sequence.
[*][b]2 new major characters[/b] revealed. One of them hinted in previous chapter 2.
Improvements and changes to story.
D-8 changed to D-7. Too many people kept telling me, “Hey Dawn, wanna go on a date?”[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26346321/917aefc108c9c1205e45d5c47394d6ab83850dd6.gif[/img]

[h1]New minimum requirements to assure 60fps gameplay:[/h1]

Geforce GTX 260
8 GB Ram
Core 2 Duo 8500
500mb HD space

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26346321/f0cdf5c4e91857619feed48a7e89e3bf2a58055b.gif[/img]

[h1]Fixes or Improvements:[/h1]

[*][b]Optimization pass #1[/b] – 400mb to 20mb game startup. 250% memory improvements throughout game.
[*][b]60 FPS cap increase[/b] – After I made the jump, some timing issues appeared. I fixed most, but there may be some speed issues lurking. You'll know what I mean if you see one. (such as animations playing too fast)
[*][b]Editing story Pass #1[/b] – Passive to active narrative voice (still editing).
[*][b]Lots of bugs squashed.[/b][/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26346321/fb70c292d7424a253ce193e50776aa742792fb8a.gif[/img]


[h1]Known Issues:[/h1]

* After he new windows 10 update: I noticed if my game started in full screen, the screen displays only black until the game is shrunk. I think I have fixed this problem, but I wanted to tell you just in case.[b]Hit Alt Enter to go to full screen.[/b]

Solution – hit alt + enter

* Clicking too fast before a dialogue choice appears will sometimes freeze conversations.
* Chapter 2 (rare bug) destroying Dreadlords fleet sometimes does not trigger the next story progression.

Solution – Load the game

notes.title: Progress Update - Chapter 3
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26346321/064010b50b6ab133d8d9258010d8d759ec0edff5.jpg[/img]

The save system has been updated again. It will go through testing once the new build is ready. I won't update the steam build until chapter 3 is ready. You can save the game to 9 slots as shown in the screen above.

These are the technical changes:

-Changed old save file system to allow multiple files
-Modified exiting pause screen
-Added Folder Tabs
-Added backdrop snapshot
-Added folder tab game snapshot
-Added folder save/load menu
-Modified Load Detect behavior

As far as the work required before uploading a new Steam build:

1) Insert 125+ pages of new dialogue with code.
2) Insert side quests and new ships for gameplay.

[h1]YOUR SHIP IDEAS:[/h1]

This is important. I created a thread so that you may submit your ship ideas. I will pick from the lot and put the ship in the game. This is a good time to post your ideas.

http://steamcommunity.com/app/529100/discussions/0/224446614459439411/
